subject: Renewal runway vs staged uplift — LoopMetrics proposal
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Caleb Wong <caleb.wong@loopmetrics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal runway vs staged uplift — LoopMetrics proposal

Hi Caleb —

Congrats again on the traction you and the ML team are getting — we pulled together a short renewal playbook for LoopMetrics that aligns current token runway with a staged uplift that gives you predictable headroom during the Q4 feature ramp. Key items attached: a compact usage export and a latency breakdown by route.

Top-level summary (TL;DR):
- Current run-rate (last 90 days): ~28M tokens / month
- Predictable runway at current commit: ~3 months before overruns
- Recommended staged uplift: +40% commit for 6 months with built-in burst credits for seasonal spikes
- Expected unit cost improvement with batching + prefix caching: ~12–18%

Asks:
1) Can you share the procurement contact for LoopMetrics so Monica can provision a sample invoice?
2) Are you available for a 30-min sync next week to walk the mutual action plan and pricing tiers (I suggested a few times in the linked Drive)?

Attachments: loopmetrics_usage_Q3.csv (usage export), latency_by_route_202610.pdf (latency heatmap)

I copied Rishi to propose the commercial options after we confirm runway.

Thanks —
Aisha

--
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0126

From: Caleb Wong <caleb.wong@loopmetrics.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@loopmetrics.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal runway vs staged uplift — LoopMetrics proposal

Thanks Aisha — appreciate the quick summary and attachments.

A few quick notes:
- This aligns with what I was expecting — the token runway is getting tight with our new summary generation feature.
- Procurement: loopmetrics-purchase@loopmetrics.com (Maria handles POs) — I've cc'd her.
- Can you break the proposed uplift into two tranches? We prefer starting with a 20% uplift and then a conditional second tranche if the feature adoption hits the forecasted threshold.

Also please include any compliance evidence we might need for procurement (SOC2 statements or audit logs) — we may need that attached for our vendor intake.

Available for a call Tue 10/05 11:00–11:30 PT or Wed 10/06 14:00–14:30 PT.

—Caleb

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Caleb Wong <caleb.wong@loopmetrics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@loopmetrics.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal runway vs staged uplift — LoopMetrics proposal

Caleb — great, thanks for the quick reply and for adding Maria.

I attached a small mutual_action_plan_loopmetrics.xlsx that lays out a two-tranche path (20% then conditional +20% after adoption milestone) and a short appendix with the compliance checklist we usually provide for vendor intake (SOC 2 summary, data retention policy, and audit log sample).

Answers inline:
- Two-tranche approach looks reasonable; we can structure a 6-month term with an automatic evaluation at month 3 tied to your adoption trigger.
- Compliance: see the attachments. If procurement needs the full SOC 2 report we can provide a redacted copy via our secure drive link (I included it in the related links).

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm PO contact & preferred billing cadence (Maria)
2) Rishi to share commercial options (commits, burst credits, and an optional reserved GPU pool for sustained low-latency workloads) on our Tue call
3) Sign MMP (mutual action plan) and route initial PO to Monica for sample invoice

I booked Tue 10/05 11:00–11:30 PT on the assumption that works — invite pending acceptance.

Attachments referenced: mutual_action_plan_loopmetrics.xlsx

Best,
Aisha

--
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@loopmetrics.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Caleb Wong <caleb.wong@loopmetrics.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal runway vs staged uplift — LoopMetrics proposal

Hi Aisha / Rishi —

Thanks — quick procurement questions before we get the PO in flight:
1) Can you provide a sample invoice and a net-30 vs net-45 pricing comparison?
2) We need to confirm whether the uplift commit will be an amendment to the existing agreement or a separate addendum. Please flag required order of operations.
3) Are there any payment holdbacks tied to SLA credits? We need that for our finance review.

If you can share a simple sample_invoice_loopmetrics.pdf and a short one-page SOW addendum we can fast-track internally.

Maria Garcia
Procurement Lead | LoopMetrics
maria.garcia@loopmetrics.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Garcia <maria.garcia@loopmetrics.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Caleb Wong <caleb.wong@loopmetrics.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal runway vs staged uplift — LoopMetrics proposal

Maria — thanks for laying out the procurement checklist. I've attached a condensed sample invoice and an SOW addendum draft (see attachments) that treats the uplift as an amendment to your existing agreement with a 3-month evaluation for the second tranche. Key commercial points:

- Tier A (baseline uplift 20%): $0.0009 / token (committed), monthly billing, net-30
- Tier B (conditional +20% after evaluation): $0.00078 / token (committed), active after adoption milestone, invoiced retroactively for the tranche period
- Burst credits: 10% monthly buffer included for 6 months; additional burst available at burst rate $0.0012 / token
- SLA holdbacks: We do not apply automatic payment holdbacks for SLA credits; credits are applied to subsequent invoices per the contract. We can negotiate escrow or other constructs if required by finance.

Action items we will take this week:
1) Monica will upload sample_invoice_loopmetrics.pdf and the SOW addendum to the Drive link and share a DocuSign envelope for signature.
2) Aisha will send the final MMP and confirm the PO contact and billing cadence.
3) Rishi will prepare a short pricing comparison (net-30 vs net-45) and a concise one-page note on SLA credit handling for your finance team.

Let us know if Tue 10/05 11:00 PT still needs to be rescheduled — otherwise we'll proceed with the call notes and share the docs via Drive/DocuSign today.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
+1 (650) 555-0199

Attachments referenced: sample_invoice_loopmetrics.pdf, mutual_action_plan_loopmetrics.xlsx
